newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raids clandestine telephone gang.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raids clandestine telephone gang.

text.p: Philippine investigators raided a basement in the capital's Makati business district on Tuesday and uncovered sophisticated equipment that enables international phone calls to be charged at local rates.
National Bureau of Investigation director Salvador Ranin told reporters six people were arrested in the raid.
The bureau had been tracking the syndicate since January after complaints from Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT), Ranin said.

He said the team found equipment that tapped into both PLDT's network and that of another local phone company, Globe Telecom, allowing the syndicate to convert international calls into cheaper local calls.
Globe recently said it had lost more than 400 million pesos ($15.25 million) due to theft.
